code_summary: One independently trained HistoryModel per category, with four-category predictor routing and exactly one selected checkpoint loaded per category. The network uses separate input/output item embeddings, last-item and mean-history features, two learned attention pools with recency decay, an MLP, layer normalization, and scaled cosine scoring with jointly trained item biases. Training uses sampled listwise cross-entropy with 64 negatives, masking current positives and prefix items, AdamW, gradient clipping, and validation-based checkpoint selection. The predictor writer loads the same architecture and selected checkpoint; parity checks are planned but did not execute.
